text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g-s and left b-a-c-k-u-p c-o-p-i-e-s in c-l-o-u-d s-t-o-r-a-g-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-n-e-t-i-c v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d by the s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d o-p-e-r-a-t-i-n-g p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e
2) the a-c-t-o-r f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s and left n-o-t-a-r-i-z-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s in the f-i-l-i-n-g b-a-s-k-e-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k a-g-a-i-n-s-t the r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e e-n-t-r-y
3) the a-c-t-o-r p-r-i-n-t-e-d c-o-p-i-e-s of i-n-v-a-l-i-d p-e-r-m-i-t-s and left s-c-a-n-n-e-d p-d-f files in the w-o-r-k-i-n-g d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of the a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e and e-x-p-i-r-y d-a-t-e f-i-e-l-d-s
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s and left p-h-o-t-o-g-r-a-p-h s-e-t-s in the m-e-d-i-a f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-v-i-e-w of the b-i-o-s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y and w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e p-r-o-t-e-c-t-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y r-u-l-e-s
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n-e-d a l-i-s-t of b-u-y-e-r-s and left c-h-a-t l-o-g-s in the m-e-s-s-a-g-i-n-g a-p-p while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the k-n-o-w-n c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p b-e-f-o-r-e a-c-c-e-p-t-i-n-g p-a-y-m-e-n-t
